family_reports.body: The court system allowed years of costly, endless interventions and unchecked abuses of power that destroyed my relationship with my son and fractured my family beyond repair. I was forced to navigate an exhausting maze of custody evaluations, therapy, supervised visits, and ever-changing requirements that ultimately deprived me of my son and the irreplaceable milestones of his childhood. What was presented as a system designed to protect children instead became a system that isolated me from my son, exhausted my resources, and robbed our family of years we can never get back.” The abuse of power I experienced through the family court system left me emotionally devastated, financially drained, and permanently separated from the everyday joys and milestones of my son’s life

Destroyed our lives, financial wellbeing, trust, future, security, mental health, and ability to live a “regular”, safe, healthy life for both child and mother. It’s created a life of walking on egg shells for almost 10 years, and no end in sight.
